initialPrompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painted landscape background for an adult language-learning board game. Create one wide 16:9 landscape, richly hand-painted oil/gouache illustration, realistic tactile detail and warm sun, elevated three-quarter bird's-eye view, like a premium European illustrated game board. Dutch outdoor market, welcoming, calm, no people. A broad EMPTY light cobblestone pedestrian route runs openly from bottom-left across the foreground, curves gently up through the central aisle between market stalls, then opens onto a sunny small square at the upper-right. NOT a loop, no central pond. Plenty of open route width for large game tiles that will be added in code. Market stalls with striped terracotta/cream and sage/cream canvas awnings, baskets of fruit, flowers, bread, wooden crates, distant brick buildings. Two awnings project partly over the side of the walkway, giving natural foreground overlap for a walking pawn; keep the ground corridor physically walkable. Compose abundant scenery around a clear route, not a cluttered maze. Landscape reaches all four edges. No letters, no text, no numbers, no signage text, NO game tiles, no geometric game symbols, no pawns, no UI. Use the attached forest board ONLY as a reference for adult painterly texture and high-angle game-board clarity, not its forest, layout or colors. New original scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painted landscape background for adult language-learning board game. One wide 16:9 image, premium detailed hand-painted oil/gouache realism, elevated three-quarter cutaway view of a modest contemporary Dutch railway station, airy cream stone and brick, teal metal roofwork, soft morning light, no people, no readable text or logos. Strong long horizontal composition with TWO distinct walkable areas separated by a railway embankment running diagonally across the middle. Lower-left is an open-roof station hall/forecourt with a very wide EMPTY paving path that gently bends from far lower left across the lower part toward a clearly visible dark pedestrian tunnel entrance in the middle-right side of the embankment. Above the embankment, a matching tunnel exit opens onto a wide safe platform walkway running from center toward a waiting train at far upper right. Tunnel doors face the viewer enough that a pawn can walk up into each dark arch. The only connection between hall path and platform path is this paired pedestrian underpass; no exposed walking route over tracks, no stairs blocking the mouths. Leave large clear forecourts at both mouths and route width for large game tiles added later. Empty walkways without colored tiles. Warm station lamps and wooden benches kept beside the path. Open space for start at lower left and finish near train at upper right. Adult richly painted family style matching reference texture; composition completely different from forest/spiral. No letters, words, numbers, game tiles, symbols, pawns, UI or watermarks. Landscape fills all edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: adult language-learning game board landscape. One very wide 16:9 richly hand-painted gouache/oil illustration, elegant realistic detail and elevated three-quarter bird's-eye composition. Arctic expedition landscape in luminous cool blue-white daylight, warm tiny lights in a modern research station high at far upper-right. Vast open ice valley, wind-carved snow and turquoise glacier walls, absolutely no forest or urban buildings. A broad EMPTY walkable packed-snow path begins lower-left, sweeps in ONE broad open arc toward the upper-left glacier ridge, disappears through a clearly visible dark snow-tunnel entrance, emerges through a separate dark snow-tunnel exit on the other side of that ridge near center, then traverses the valley on a wide ledge to the foot of a nearly vertical glacier wall in the right third. A simple visible industrial vertical lift shaft connects lower path to a wide upper ledge; aligned bottom and top landings, a straight lift guide mast, no zigzag stairs. Upper path continues right to the research station. Keep enough safe snow surface for 30 board-game tiles added in code, with spacious gaps between route arms and obstacles. Tunnel mouths face viewer, dark inside, clear ground in front. Lift not a cable car: a short vertical elevator along the cliff, room for a small platform later animated in code. The glacier is continuous land, not floating islands, no three terraced zigzags, no huge central waterbody. No people, no polar animals needed. Painted texture family of reference but cooler, more spacious, distinct terrain. No text, no letters, no numbers, no game tiles or symbols, no pawns, no UI, no watermark.
